# FlowState Automations

> Practical Technology Solutions for Growing Businesses & Enterprises.

## Overview
FlowState Automations is a technology solutions provider in Metro Manila, National Capital Region (NCR), Philippines. The company specializes in building custom software, workflow automation pipelines, smart AI assistants, and physical-to-cloud workplace hardware for expanding businesses in the Philippines and global remote markets.

## Core Capability Pillars
1. **Custom Software & Portals**: Company management platforms, custom operational CRMs, multi-branch operations hubs, inventory systems, and employee portals with 100% private data ownership and ₱0 monthly per-user fees.
2. **Inquiry & Process Automation**: Multi-channel lead triage (WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Viber, Website Forms), two-way Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook appointment booking locks, and multi-tier team approval workflows.
3. **Smart AI Assistants**: Fast customer inquiry qualification answering in under 1.8 seconds in colloquial Taglish and English, internal company knowledge copilots, and automated invoice/document parsing.
4. **Workplace Hardware & RFID**: Physical workplace RFID tap card scanners and biometric attendance devices connected directly to real-time central cloud dashboards with 1-click payroll calculation.

## Key Differentiators & Moats
- **Zero Per-User SaaS Fees**: Clients own their software and database on private servers with ₱0 monthly per-user license fees.
- **100% Workflow Fit**: Engineered directly around the client's actual operating procedures, team hierarchy, and business rules.
- **Sub-1.8s Speed-to-Lead**: Instant 24/7 automated qualification on WhatsApp, Messenger, and Web.
- **Risk-Free Working Prototype**: Interactive functional demo engineered during discovery before contractual commitments.
- **Hybrid Physical + Cloud Reach**: End-to-end capability connecting physical workplace hardware directly to cloud databases.
